detail: Red on hbox batch 3 (bdd4f40c4), lat1 batch 4 (55ff708a6) and lat1:/tank/fn/scratch/fill-wt/native-fill-smoke-lat1 (fill-smoke-lat1, set 55ff708a6, tests.test_native_web 2 of 15). Not a box effect (same two fail on hbox). tests/test_native_web.py:250 article_bytes.

notes.author: Codex / lane send-window-2
notes.note: Related train-51 RemoteDisconnected at test_native_web.py:255 is the first HTTP ARTICLE GET, before restart; the copied stderr contains operator output, not the class node trace. The unchanged train-51 image passed the isolated test and all 15 web tests in controls sw2-web-control and sw2-web-control-all on hbox, so the original intermittent close is not conclusively attributed. Two concrete host deadline defects are repaired: the 15-second intake deadline no longer includes server rendering after ACL2 reports a complete request, and completed ready/render/replay quanta reset line-since (as the NNTP mux already does). Wire windows now use existing ACL2 send-progress verdicts, including no-readiness stall checks; named timeout/cold/send logs distinguish future closes. Deterministic tests execute the deployed consumers and the send-progress book bodies; restoring either old deadline defect makes their assertions fail. This does not close the earlier native NNTP 403 item.
